name: smwmusic-the-s-factor-sonia-and-silver-speed-of-sand-arid-temple-zone-act
title: The S Factor: Sonia And Silver - Speed of Sand ~ Arid Temple Zone Act 1 (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Arid Temple Zone Act 1 from The S Factor: Sonia and Silver. One of the very first romhacks (in general) I've ever played, and I have loads of nostalgia for it. Really wanted to arrange one of the original compositions from this game and finally got to doing it with one of the Arid Temple Zone.

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom 1 Pitch)
2. A Minor (Custom 2 Pitch)
